newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX SUBSTANTIAL SHAREHOLDING NOTICES - AUG 14.
newsitem.headline: ASX SUBSTANTIAL SHAREHOLDING NOTICES - AUG 14.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices were made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) yesterday.
NRMA Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Angus & Coote (Holdings) Limited on 01/08/1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Portman Mining Limited on 13/08/1997, from 8,156,209 ordinary shares (7.51%) to 9,298,719 ordinary shares (8.55%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Foodland Associated Limited on 13/08/1997, from 10,316,347 ordinary shares (10.71%) to 11,382,284 ordinary shares (11.82%).
ADC Telecommunications Inc decreased its relevant interest in Netcomm Limited o n 08/08/1997, from 2,597,403 ordinary shares (15.7%) to 1,297,403 ordinary shares (7.07%).
Axiom Properties Limited increased its relevant interest in Resource & Industry Limited on 13/08/1997, from 6,697,109 ordinary shares (16.8%) to 7,429,836 ordinary shares (18.6%).
Deutsche Australia Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Burswood Property Trust on 22/07/1997.
Deutsche Australia Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Energy Developments Limited on 11/08/1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Seven Network Limited on 11/08/1997, from 17,330,105 ordinary shares (5.93%) to 21,349,334 ordinary shares (6.97%).
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd changed its relevant interest in Schroders Property Fund on 12/08/1997, from 64,906,510 ordinary shares (18.64%) to 65,189,666 ordinary shares (17.63%).
Max Resources NL & Subsidiaries increased its relevant interest in Intrepid Mining Corporation NL on 12/08/1997, from 15,656,000 ordinary shares (28.53%) to 16,279,750 ordinary shares (29.67%).
Simeon Wines Limited increased its relevant interest in Australian Vintage Limited on 06/08/1997, from 27,596,935 ordinary shares (74.77%) to 30,966,198 ordinary shares (83.90%).
AMP Society increased its relevant interest in Asia Pacific Specialty Chemicals Limited on 13/08/1997, from 3,083,400 ordinary shares (7.05%) to 5,400,311 ordinary shares (8.20%).
Australian Mutual Provident Society decreased its relevant interest in Ausdrill Limited on 11/08/1997, from 5,337,382 ordinary shares (7.86%) to 4,622,087 ordinary shares (6.81%).

Falcore Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in West Oil NL on 13/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 11,000,000 ordinary shares (36.065%). The company also holds 1,600,000 Contributing shares.
AMP Society became a substantial shareholder in Pan Australian Resources NL on 08/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 7,600,000 ordinary shares (9.15%).
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Ci Technologies Group Limited on 12/08/1997 from 2,631,767 ordinary shares (5.16%) to 3,827,556 ordinary shares (7.51%).
Colonial Limited became a substantial shareholder in Seven Network Limited on 12/08/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 15,611,002 ordinary shares (5.09%).
Advance Synergy Bhd increased its relevant interest in Australasian Gold Mines NL on 07/08/1997, from 18,000,000 ordinary shares (21.95%) to 20,100,000 ordinary shares (22.81%).
Synergy Gold Incorporated increased its relevant interest in Australasian Gold Mines NL on 07/08/1997, from 18,000,000 ordinary shares (21.95%) to 20,100,000 ordinary shares (22.81%).
